entities.summary: Hermann Jacobsen was a German succulent researcher and horticulturist. Jacobsen directed the Kyiv Botanical Garden from 1929 to 1963. The standard author abbreviation H.Jacobsen is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
